'''Kyle Kessenich Mos Eisley Shuffle Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Kessenich]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut]]
* '''Strategy:''' Mos Eisley Shuffle Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag Mos Eisley Shuffle Deck Kessenich L.txt |Download]]
